This is not denial of dignity to adults; it is recognition that adult rights claims do not automatically override the specific, measurable advantages children receive in complete parental environments. Enforcing this standard through law protects the integrity of the adoption system itself. Prospective parents who cannot form a mother-father household remain free to pursue guardianship arrangements, kinship care, or other private support without the state conferring equivalent status. The focus stays fixed where it belongs—on delivering the most favorable conditions for the child rather than redefining family to accommodate ideological demands.
